WatchHomePromo.title: Amezruy ur yettbeddel ara. Tarrayt i medden ttwaɣren tella.
WatchHomePromo.description: Negguma-d akka tibratin-nneɣ n tvidyo d tɣiwin s uqerru n uzni, ad nsebber idrisen n usekfel i yinawen andamen i d-ittawin medden, ttwaɣren, d ttbeḍḍilen yakan.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Tibratin n tfilmin i yettwaẓraben aṭas deg umaḍal
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Idrisen n usekfel, yettweḥṣen s imeẓla n tneɣrit, bnan-d tibratin s udrar n yizeḍwan n tutlayin i wakken medden ad zren tudert n Jesus deg tutlayt i t-id-yewḍen.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Aqqaṛ n yimeslayen i yettwassnen ɣer tmeslalin timaynutin
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Negguma-d amek ara d-ttwaḥekken tudrin n lɣospel s wudem, s usemres n ttraductions yettwassnen d tmeslalin timaynutin i wakken awenni ad yezmir ad yeffeɣ s tlibert ɣef yisnawen, tigawt, d iskranen.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Ila mačči kan d tibratin. D tirmi n tmissi.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project d tirmi tamaṛrut n yesseqdec, imezra, imsɛayen n tvidyo, d yinagmayen i yettwassen i wakken ad nerr idrisen n tmissi ɣer wid i yettwarebban i tḍsa n tazmert deg meṛṛa.
WatchHomePromo.buildingNext: Acu ara neg awal s uḍris d-iteddun
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Qaren i wid i ttzemmren ɣer tazmert-nsen s tferka tizegrek, ad d-sken ad yal-k tikkelt i d-iteddun ɣer tagdud, taqbaylit, neɣ tmissi.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Tibratin tazayit n tmedya n Taqbaylit s uḍris n tvidyo, tifilmin, d iɣbula yellan deg waṭas n tutlayin i tmissi d tazmert deg umaḍal.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Asefrek n tvidyo, azuzer n ugbur, taɣbula n wawal n yilewlen, d tmuɣliwin yettwasnen i wakken ad isɛun tmissi aṭas n medden s wudem iɣewṛen.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Mudd afus i usnerni n <highlight>tarbaɛt tamaynut</highlight> n yifecka n tmissi
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Nettaru-d imeẓla, imsɛayen, d imeṛkumen ɣer usqedec amezwaru. Jeṛṛeb ifecka nniḍen mezwar, efk tuddsa, d mmeslay ɣef tsugert n ifukal yettwasnen i wergaz n tmissi.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Ẓer amas-nneɣ n tividyo d yiɣbula i d-ttaken i Taqbaylit tudert s tudrin i yettwasnen d uselmed.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Arewlu ɣer umuddu n Advent s yiwen n tvidyo n yal ass i d-ittaken asirem i Nnayan, s usenfali n lɛid, afṛaḥ, d lamal n ussufeɣ n Jesus.
